managementAccessReview.observation: Current files require a private-network-capable installer but identify no verified execution host or connectivity receipt. No private access is inferred from local tooling, portal access or resource definitions.
managementAccessReview.preferredConstrainedRoute: Run existing azd, image push, fixture/agent installation and private runtime checks on a verified existing VNet-connected operator/automation host. Its authorized route must reach the scenario private endpoints and resolve linked private DNS; the local portal worker is not assumed connected.
managementAccessReview.artifactAndResultFlow: Transfer the exact hash-verified scenario bundle through the execution host's approved artifact channel; use its authorized identity for installation, retain nonsecret output receipts and return redacted validation logs to this workspace. Do not transfer CLI credentials or tokens.
managementAccessReview.acceptance: From the actual execution host verify private DNS, TCP/TLS and authenticated ACR, Blob, Foundry and Key Vault operations; test expected outside-network and unauthorized denial separately after provisioning.
managementAccessReview.ifUnavailable: Before deployment, present one consolidated repair covering a concrete connected runner or private management host, bootstrap, DNS, identity, quota, lifecycle and costs. No VM, Bastion, VPN, runner, peering or public firewall exception is included or authorized by this local checkpoint.
managementAccessReview.rejectedShortcut: A public-IP allowlist cannot reach disabled public data planes and will not replace private connectivity.

deploymentOrderingReview.observation: azure.yaml defines the real application service but contains no lifecycle hooks. Existing documentation describes foundation, installation and workload ordering rather than an executable end-to-end azd lifecycle.
deploymentOrderingReview.localWorkAfterConfirmation: Preserve existing files and installation helpers; validate them, then wire idempotent azd lifecycle ordering and automatic output capture locally. Do not create successive user-facing technical approval stages.
deploymentOrderingReview.singleFutureReview: Cover the complete reference, resource group, private foundation, image delivery, identity writes, fixtures, agents, key, workload, gateway, runtime acceptance and execution access in one exact-target review after authorized preparation.
deploymentOrderingReview.authorization: No azd environment initialized, image published, Azure query, directory call, what-if or deployment executed.

costReview.usageEnvelope: 100 handoffs: at most 700 Responses requests and 3000000 combined input/output tokens under existing limits; price input and output separately using actual target rates.
costReview.managementCost: Existing connected-host allocation, artifact transfer, network and operational charges must be included even if no new host is provisioned. Any new management resources require a consolidated priced design/scope repair first.
costReview.nextEvidence: Produce a dated itemized estimate and actual independent what-if during separately authorized preparation; disclose identity-dependent checks. A formula or historical resource presence is not a cost quote or deployment consent.
